name: Spider-Ham

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Sık kaçar, E1'in kışkırtmasıyla saldırı gücünü azaltır, iğneleriyle özel saldırı kullanımını engeller. Kaçışı önleyen veya yetenek azaltan şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Hamming It Up
Whenever Spider-Ham Evades, he places a Porker Popper on the Opponent.
Whenever Spider-Ham is Struck while Stunned, 30% chance to remove 1 Spider-Nonsense and place a non-stacking Porker Popper on the Opponent.
These Porker Poppers last for [7 - 14] second(s) and deal [4,003.65] Damage.
While Spider-Nonsense is at 10, it lasts for an additional [0.2 - 2] second(s) before resetting.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: +[375] Physical Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Nonsense - Max 10
content: Spider-Ham's cartoonish nature increases the more danger he is in. Spider-Nonsense starts at 0 and increases over time as long as the Opponent has at least 1 Bar of Power, increasing faster for each additional Bar of Power they have.
Every stack of Spider-Nonsense reduces Degeneration effect potency by 15%, and Passively reduces damage taken during the Opponent's Special Attacks by 5%.
While Spider-Nonsense is at 6 or more, Spider-Ham has a 35% chance to Evade. This Evade will not trigger while Blocking.
While Spider-Nonsense is at 10, Spider-Ham will not gain any for 6.5 second(s), after which it resets back to 0. Spider-Nonsense resets to 3 against Mystic Champions.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Remove 2 Spider-Nonsense.

abilitySections.title: Medium Attacks
content: 50% chance to place a Porker Popper on the Opponent for 9 second(s), dealing [6,863.4] Direct Damage when they activate a Special Attack.
The chance is increased by 25% flat if the Opponent is Stunned or Spider-Ham is Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Dash Back and Hold Block
content: Activate Spider-Sense, granting 100% chance to Evade. This Evade will trigger even while Blocking.
When this Evade triggers, Spider-Sense goes on cooldown for 12 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Evade Effects
content: Whenever Spider-Ham Evades, he becomes Unblockable for 1.2 seconds and inflicts the Opponent with a Taunt Debuff for 7 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Porker Poppers
content: Any Power Sting Debuff on the Opponent is automatically upgraded into a Patent Pending Peter Porker Power Popper Debuff. Porker Poppers are still treated as Power Stings for all other abilities.
Whenever a Porker Popper is triggered, there is a 8.5% chance per Spider-Nonsense for it to be replaced by 1 new Porker Popper(s), each lasting 9 second(s) and dealing [6,863.4] Damage.
Porker Poppers deal a burst of up to [8,579.25] additional Passive Direct Damage when they trigger, scaling with how much Power the Opponent had.
The additional damage is increased by 60% for each Bar of Power the Opponent had when they were triggered.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Pause any Porker Poppers currently on the Opponent until they activate a Special Attack.
After this Special Attack, Taunt the Opponent for 7 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack is Unblockable if the Opponent is Taunted.
Set Spider-Nonsense to 10, and pause its reset timer for 7 second(s).
Place 3 Porker Poppers on the Opponent, each lasting 9 second(s) and dealing [6,863.4] Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the Opponent has triggered fewer than 15 Porker Poppers in this fight, place 4 Porker Popper(s) on them.

If the Opponent has triggered 15 or more Porker Poppers in this fight, place a Porker Popper on them for every Porker Popper that was triggered. This can only occur once per fight. Max: 25 Porker Poppers.
Each Porker Popper placed by this Attack lasts for 10 second(s) and deals [6,863.4] Damage.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Hamming It Up
content: Whenever Spider-Ham Evades, he places a Porker Popper on the Opponent.
Whenever Spider-Ham is Struck while Stunned, 30% chance to remove 1 Spider-Nonsense and place a non-stacking Porker Popper on the Opponent.
These Porker Poppers last for [7 - 14] second(s) and deal [4,003.65] Damage.
While Spider-Nonsense is at 10, it lasts for an additional [0.2 - 2] second(s) before resetting.
